purpose: Append-only Calibration-v6 independent data design. Repair v4/v5 insufficient-evidence collision/margin failures and inherited AMBIGUOUS candidate-sphere overlaps, enforcing the user-required 10mm clearance for all active object pairs across every state. Preserve all scientific gates.

observed_pre_render_failure.source_of_radii: Locked world SDF collision sphere radii, not RGB or model outcomes.
observed_pre_render_failure.v5_result: BLOCKED_PRE_RENDER_GEOMETRY; conservative interval lower bounds failed 10mm on rightmost pair/panel and second-from panel. No v5 render or inference.

additional_prior_template_diagnosis.source: frozen v3 SDF collision radii and scene poses, read-only geometric diagnosis before v6 preregistration

inherit_unchanged.risk_model: frozen spatial-risk v2 binary and exact 12 ordered oracle-free features; never refit
inherit_unchanged.world_camera_and_view_pose: Frozen v3/v4 Gazebo world, 640x480 wrist camera intrinsics/frame and six-joint view pose; no viewpoint change
inherit_unchanged.answerability: Same FOUND/AMBIGUOUS/ABSENT/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE definitions and 4 horizontal ordinal relations
inherit_unchanged.visibility_gate: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE target 1 <= semantic pixels < 120, in inherited projected-center margin; EVERY other candidate >= 120 visible pixels; other state/geometry gates unchanged
inherit_unchanged.method_and_metrics: Inherit v3 parent scientific contract without changing unsafe, ECE-10, Brier, AURC, AUROC-error, Hit@0.08, bootstrap, exact McNemar, positive-slope affine-logit objective, optimizer, initialization, bounds, success/failure gates, or 101-point threshold grid and lexicographic rule
inherit_unchanged.claim_boundary: Static geometry PASS or pilot QC PASS is infrastructure/data evidence, never scientific calibration PASS

population_and_independence.capture_order_rule: sort by full SHA-256 of protocol_id + '_capture_order_v1|' + family_id; no ties
population_and_independence.mandatory_exclusions: Both v6 splits disjoint from each other and every prior successful/failed Dev/UQ/Calibration/pilot/characterization attempt in family/scene/layout ID, seed, canonical physical signature and post-capture RGB. Include regenerated v4 static-preview signatures without rendering; v5 generated no scenes. Only public exclusion metadata for Test; never open Test data.
population_and_independence.reuse_forbidden: No prior row, image, label for calibration fitting, seed or complete physical layout may be reused. Frozen v3 annotations may supply only predefined query/asset-identity/rank templates; all active candidate locations are newly constructed. Keep fixed IE target/panel mechanism as explicitly allowed geometry template.
population_and_independence.no_adaptive_scenes: Do not resample, select, delete, replace or mix individual families after observing pilot or calibration outcomes.

exact_geometry_revision.repair_scope: All active candidate centers use the fixed v6 camera-space anchor tables below, rather than translated v3 layouts. This also repairs physically intersecting AMBIGUOUS spheres and creates new interior-image FOUND/ABSENT layouts to enforce the same all-state analytic margins. No change to answerability definitions, assets, camera, visibility or scientific metric gates.
exact_geometry_revision.fixed_target_occluder_geometry: Reuse the frozen v3 geometry template for the target plus neutral visual-only occluder; do not reuse v3 images or calibration labels. The inherited center-projection and target visibility gate remains unchanged.
exact_geometry_revision.candidate_identity_to_anchor: Sort the two non-target candidate IDs lexicographically; assign index 0 to the first anchor and index 1 to the second anchor for each relation.
exact_geometry_revision.per_family_fixed_jitter: For anchor slot i=0,1,2 and frozen uint32 seed h: u=anchor_u+0.0040*(((h>>(8*i)) mod 5)-2); v=anchor_v+0.0050*(((h>>(8*i+3)) mod 5)-2). Continuous independent envelope |du|<=0.008, |dv|<=0.010 is certified for all slots, even when seed bits correlate. yaw=0.0700+0.0070*((h>>(16+3*i)) mod 11). IE target/panel have zero jitter. No resampling.
exact_geometry_revision.candidate_pose: Inverse-project (u*640,v*480) with frozen camera intrinsics and camera-to-base TF onto that asset's horizontal support plane z from frozen v3 scene object config; preserve asset identity and support z. yaw=0.0700+0.0070*((h>>(16+3*i)) mod 11). Bind exact camera transform, projection implementation and resulting pose signatures in a subsequent implementation lock before rendering.
exact_geometry_revision.non_insufficient_states: Use frozen v3 annotations for corresponding state/relation/repetition (pilot repetition 0,1; calibration 0..7), NEVER v3 candidate coordinates. FOUND: assign annotated target to ordinal slot rank-1 for rank_from=left, or 3-rank for right; fill remaining ascending-u slots with remaining candidate IDs sorted lexicographically. AMBIGUOUS: sorted valid_target_ids occupy slots 0,1 (same u, different v); remaining candidate occupies slot 2. Use TIE_LEFT for leftmost/second_from_left, TIE_RIGHT for rightmost/second_from_right. ABSENT: sorted context_ids occupy slots 0,1 and absent target remains at storage. Occluder stays at storage except IE. Exact instruction/output contract and target identity stay inherited.

collision_clearance_from_world_sdf.candidate_pair: EVERY pair of active fruit candidates/context objects in every state, including target, must have XY center-distance minus the two actual SDF collision sphere radii >=0.010m throughout the entire continuous jitter envelope. Deliberate image-x tie in AMBIGUOUS does not exempt physical separation.
collision_clearance_from_world_sdf.candidate_to_target: Each candidate sphere to mango collision sphere XY distance minus radii must be >= 0.010 m; the mango–panel intentional visual overlap is exempt.
collision_clearance_from_world_sdf.candidate_to_panel: Use the exact 0.100 x 0.100 m visual-only occluder footprint rotated by its frozen yaw; point-to-oriented-rectangle minimum planar distance minus candidate sphere radius must be >= 0.010 m. The panel is collision-free but visual overlap with non-target candidates is forbidden.
collision_clearance_from_world_sdf.candidate_to_table_edge: Work table from frozen SDF has x bounds [-0.8,0.8] m and y bounds [-0.65,1.55] m; each candidate center must be at least its SDF collision radius + 0.010 m inside every edge.

projection_and_relation_guards.candidate_image_center_envelope: 0.08 <= u,v <= 0.92 throughout the entire fixed jitter envelope
projection_and_relation_guards.relation_order: Target projected x is strictly left of both candidates for leftmost, right of both for rightmost, and strictly between them for each second-from relation. All four checks must hold throughout the entire jitter envelope.
projection_and_relation_guards.target_near_image_and_valid_depth: Apply the inherited v3 projected-center rule and depth range unchanged
projection_and_relation_guards.all_state_relation_rule: FOUND adjacent ascending-u intervals strictly separated by more than inherited 0.03 tie margin; AMBIGUOUS tied pair worst-case image-u difference <=0.03 and both lie on annotated left/right side of third candidate with >0.03 separation; ABSENT target absent and both context centers in image; IE target relation order as inherited. Semantic-mask centroid order and pixel visibility remain mandatory post-render QC, not proved by center geometry.

exact_geometry_revision.certificate_rule: After data-design hash lock, run one read-only certificate covering all anchor classes and asset assignments, not sampled seeds or scene generation. Use frozen TF and SDF radii, inverse-project four corners of each normalized-u/v envelope and outward-pad XY bounds by 1e-12m. Certify conservative AABB distance minus radii >=10mm, table support (sphere bottom at table top within 1e-6m), table edges, camera forward/inverse roundtrip and valid depth, image guards, IE panel clearance, and state-specific ordinal/tie conditions. Enumerate all six asset permutations for FOUND, all six ordered asset pairs for ABSENT, fixed apple/orange ties with mango context for AMBIGUOUS, and both IE candidates plus frozen mango/panel. On any unproved constraint, freeze failure and STOP; do not edit anchors or rerun a revised certificate.
exact_geometry_revision.post_render_qc_rule: Analytic clearance cannot prove semantic visibility. Only a separately authorized, all-or-nothing rendered pilot with 32/32 PASS (including 8/8 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with each non-target candidate >=120 pixels) may authorize a distinct 128-family calibration capture.

gate_order: hash-lock v6 data design and verify immutable predecessors
read-only worst-case pre-render certificate with no generated scenes, RGB or labels
only if certificate PASS, build deterministic generator/scene/config/manifests and freeze full implementation plus disjointness audit
static/live preflight, separately authorized single pilot capture, then pilot 32/32 geometry/RGB/TF/leakage QC
only if pilot PASS, separately authorize one new 128-family calibration capture; QC all 128/128 before materialization or inference

only if calibration QC PASS, frozen B0 and risk v2 inference, raw prediction locks before oracle join, fit calibrator once, apply inherited probability/ranking/operating-point gates, report one honest v6 scientific decision
Test-IID/OOD and Gazebo/real robot remain sealed even if v6 calibration PASS

policy.static_certificate_failure_rule: Freeze negative static certificate and STOP. Any new anchors need a NEW append-only data-design revision, never an edit of this file.
policy.pilot_or_calibration_qc_failure_rule: Freeze entire attempt and STOP before inference; this is a data failure, not a scientific calibrator negative.

scientific_terminal_decisions.fit_split: Gazebo_calibration_v6 only after all 128/128 QC; exactly one affine-logit fit
scientific_terminal_decisions.metric_null_rule: On pre-render/pilot/data failure, metrics and scientific decision are null; scientific hypothesis NOT_TESTED.
scientific_terminal_decisions.inherited_rule: Inherit every v3 scientific procedure verbatim, replacing only protocol/dataset names. Test/robot remain sealed even on PASS.

execution_authority: User explicitly authorized progression through preflights, separately hash-locked pilot/calibration capture authorizations, and one calibrator fit iff each predecessor gate PASS. Authorization artifact is separate from this preregistration and must bind actual PASS evidence. No permission for Test or robot.
